subject: [PATCH v3 07/11] mm, swap: reclaim physical slots backing cache-only vswap entries

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch reclaims physical slots backing cache-only vswap entries to free up physical capacity for new allocations when the swap space is more than half used. A vswap entry becomes cache-only when its swap_count drops to zero but the folio remains in the swap cache, making the associated physical slot redundant and reclaimable. The patch introduces a flag to mark such slots as cache-only and adds code to reclaim them from the physical reclaim scanner.
